label: S07 Marina Bay Resorts (Dubai, collides with Al Noor)

details.title: Master Services Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of India and the courts of Pune have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote: Marina Bay Resorts LLC, a company incorporated in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, having its registered office at Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai ("Marina Bay"); and AtliQ Technologies Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("Vendor").

payment_source.quote: Marina Bay shall pay USD 150,000 in total, within thirty (30) days of receipt of each invoice.

details.services_summary: Revenue-management analytics, guest analytics services, and a booking-engine module for four resorts.

liability_cap.basis: fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim
liability_cap.quote: Each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Vendor shall not provide revenue-management services to any other hotel group in the United Arab Emirates for six months after the end of the term.
restrictive_covenants.quote: For six (6) months after the end of the term, Vendor shall not provide revenue-management services to any other hotel group in the United Arab Emirates.

titles: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services

all_findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
all_findings.why: Al Noor non-compete prohibits data analytics, AI, or revenue-management services for any hospitality business in the UAE until 2029.
all_findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
all_findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
all_findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.

all_findings.title: Post-Term Exclusivity Restriction
all_findings.why: Restricts AtliQ from working with other clients in the UAE region for six months post-term.
all_findings.quote: For six (6) months after the end of the term, Vendor shall not provide revenue-management services to any other hotel group in the United Arab Emirates.
